description: This Java class provides utility methods for handling image content in a content repository, including MIME type validation, extracting images from data URLs, determining file extensions, and generating random strings.

classes.name: ContentRepositoryUtils
classes.description: Utility class for image processing and validation within content repository management.

methods.name: imageExtensionFromFileName
methods.description: Determines the image file extension based on the filename.

methods.name: validateImageMimeType
methods.description: Validates that the provided MIME type is a supported image type.

methods.name: extractImageFromDataURL
methods.description: Extracts a Base64 encoded image and its extension from a data URL.

methods.name: validateFileSizeWithinPermissibleRange
methods.description: Checks if the file size exceeds the maximum allowed upload size.

methods.name: validateClientImageNotEmpty
methods.description: Ensures that the image filename parameter is not null or empty.

methods.name: generateRandomString
methods.description: Generates a random alphanumeric string of length between 5 and 16.
